## Why this is the next complete control unit

The existing slot_ledger.hepta image owns 19 decisions and a private numeric
fold. NativeSlotLedgerStore still owns all ordering between those decisions,
SQL and callbacks. Its adopt path can perform two INSERTs before its later
fold INIT/STEP/FINISH calls. Its suffix can perform two more SQL effects after
the final numeric decision. A narrow transition wrapper cannot account for
the whole series of effects.

The new proposed HIA controller owns all 15 class methods, their branches,
original loops, exception continuation decisions and terminal publication.
No selected method calls a retained whole Python method. Actual dynamic
self._execute, self._call, self._begin, self.lease, self.validate_u64 and
self._lease_value calls remain dynamic. Their default public bindings enter
the corresponding HIA mode; valid overrides still execute as the original
foreign callback. This avoids bypassing LOAD_METHOD or narrowing descriptors,
static methods, instance attributes and replacement callables.

The existing _text, _decimal, _untext, request_packet, _claimed_artifact_wire,
_raise and _custody remain explicitly named encoding/diagnostic providers in
this migration unit. In particular, _raise still owns its current diagnostic
mapping. wire/decode_data/digest, proof/native callbacks, SQLite, entropy and
Python object protocols remain foreign providers. None of this is claimed to
be a full language-native SQLite or whole-stack rewrite. These boundaries
must remain visible in the final inventory instead of being hidden in a
generic effect wrapper.

## Original-only finite input revision

cases.json fixes 248 inputs: 124 definitions, each with outer-exception false
and true. There are 21 base templates, 45 behavioral variants, 30 SQL fault
definitions (before/after all 15 literal SQL sites), 24 additional lookup/
provider fault definitions and 4 process-control fault definitions. The
retained-traceback variant contains its own specified lookup fault. No
expectation is generated from a candidate, port graph or repaired method.

The whole original class and exact support nodes are compiled into an isolated
namespace. Relative imports resolve only explicitly installed fake modules.
The observer never imports a product module. Original AgentRejected, reject
and keys nodes come from the frozen actual AgentStore source. In particular,
the lease dictionary remains an exact dict because original keys() checks that.

Providers are deliberately finite, declared fakes:
- fake SQL records exact original statement/parameter order and a fake effect
  prefix; it does not connect to SQLite or assert real transaction behavior;
- the image decodes original request_packet bytes and returns a declared
  scripted receipt; it does not simulate or qualify HIA arithmetic;
- entropy, workspace allocation, UUID, callback native output and JSON/data
  providers are explicit fixtures, not production replacements.

Every supplied fault must fire exactly once. A wrong statement, unexpected
opcode, missing fault, unraisable callback error or changed source is an
observer HOLD, never accepted as an ordinary business exception. Ordinary
original exceptions, including MemoryError and process-control objects, are
recorded with class, args, cause, context, suppression, name, obj and identity.
No metadata is normalized. Source-defined runtime differences remain visible.

The temporary Store / detached execute / detached fetch cases use weak
observations only. World stores primitive trace data and weakrefs, not
temporary Store, DB, cursor, callable, receipt, workspace or result references.
Probe classes are fixed module-level types. Original method globals/functions
are created once per fresh child, avoiding one new class/namespace cycle per
case. A World reference cannot recover its Subject except via a weakref.
The original method holds all ordinary live arguments/locals.

Consumer-release and optional retained-traceback-release are explicit phases.
Only input cases with collect=true invoke their per-case explicit GC phase.
Each complete record is deep-copied and immediately written as canonical
ensure_ascii=True JSON, preserving lone surrogates. A separately named final
whole-run GC diagnostic captures all later events without rewriting a sealed
observation. It is not passed off as synchronous destructor behavior or as
production qualification. The fake acyclic Store fixture does not claim that
real AgentStore (including its execution-budget back-reference) is acyclic.

run_originals_twice.py launches the entire fixed list twice in fresh processes
for each explicitly named interpreter. Each child has a new diagnostic 180
second limit and 5 second owned cleanup. It records commands, source pins,
runtime, full raw exceptions, all IDs and every observation. Original pairs
must match within the same runtime; versions are never compared against a
single historical expected hash. Existing test budgets are unchanged.

## HIA control graph and primitive map

port-map.json contains every mode and 46 primitive kinds. sql-sites.json
contains all 15 exact original literal call expressions, argument expressions,
line anchors and ASTs. Each SQL site remains its own literal expression.

The controller graph is:

1. Initialize an exact invocation and bind original argument/local handles.
2. HIA issues the next operation for the current mode/phase.
3. Host claims that exact operation and executes only its literal provider.
4. The provider returns an opaque value or raises the actual exception.
5. HIA validates the exact receipt and determines the next phase, branch,
   loop iteration, exception continuation or terminal action.
6. Only a fully validated terminal may return or propagate the confirmed
   original exception. Native loss fences the invocation and its actual
   associated series/resources, without replay or fallback.

The proposed new ABI has a distinct version/magic, 128-byte request, 96-byte
receipt and 192-byte controller workspace. It is not generated, compiled,
profiled or admitted. The old HIASLRQ1 decision packet and 128-byte fold state
remain unchanged. Arbitrary Python integers and objects are handles; no new
integer, string, row, history or nesting cap is introduced by the proposal.
All source, SSA, compiler, VM and scratch limits must be checked using the
original project gates after generation, rather than asserted from this plan.

Important mode edges:
- snapshot performs the slots read, version read and active-lease count in the
  original order; a missing slot skips the latter two.
- conditional validates generation, then epoch, then calls the supplied
  snapshot reader. Its stale-error attribute assignment and bare rethrow
  stay in the original active AgentRejected handler.
- admit_evaluation reads each correctness field only after the previous
  native decision succeeds. Its direct transition18 is distinct from _call.
  Unhashable diagnostic membership still occurs only after the native refusal.
- adopt uses the original plan.action branch. The cursor is consumed one row
  at a time; no pre-listing, SQLite integer coercion or artificial row cap.
- rollback checks retained existence before artifact decoding/native callback,
  then ABI, numeric epoch, UPDATE and result, in the original order.
- lease validates keys before any DB selection. It observes row['active']
  twice only on the original exact-int path, admits the earlier descriptor
  before touching artifact, and keeps the selected renderer failure path.
- release dynamically calls lease and then performs its own UPDATE.

HIA determines policy; Python is not allowed to add a rollback, cleanup retry,
COMMIT, loop limit or eligibility decision as a safety fallback. Partial
effects continue to rely on the caller's existing transaction where it had one.

## Literal boundaries and lifetime fidelity

A port cannot split an original chained temporary into a long-lived host
reference merely to make resource capture convenient. In particular, the
original self._execute(...).fetchone() expression and snapshot count [0] chain
remain a single literal provider where that preserves LOAD_METHOD and
temporary release. The _execute public default itself enters HIA mode 2;
a replacement method remains an actual dynamic call.

For captured db locals, the original healthy local ownership may be kept.
For temporary Store receivers, a weak identity-only tap may occur exactly at
the original value position, once, with no pre-read or repeated getter.
Unregistered receivers are not guessed into lifetime custody. Raw DB objects
that cannot be weakly registered remain an explicit boundary.

Every error path must be checked against the actual same-runtime oracle before
choosing local release order. HIA must own each release continuation; a blanket
Python finally clearing a dict would replace original exception policy.
The default controller must also preserve bound-callable timing and active
exception state when a provider raises, suppresses, replaces or reenters.

## Three independent custody lifetimes

The current d90 shared source is weak-R3, SHA256
7a6f4d10915966116567b96849d93e26e7dd26f3990a647d931d24495f26008c.
Its ForeignCall.borrow_registered_resource and resource_call_arguments are
single-occurrence mechanisms. _borrow_prepared/_borrow_armed are one-shot;
resetting either field to reuse an activation is forbidden.

A multi-SQL operation requires three independent lifetimes:

| Lifetime | Begins | Finishes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Statement occurrence | Capacity, exact identity and original final-argument guard are prepared before one execute | That occurrence's exact result delivery, with its actual attempt/return facts retained as required by the series |
| Whole Slot operation | Before the first possible external effect in this invocation | Complete controller terminal receipt, not an intermediate decision-image ACK |
| Actual opted-in ancestor | During pre-effect reservation for a genuinely live ancestor activation | That ancestor's own complete ACK; a child terminal cannot clear it |

Each statement needs a new activation and fact. All allocation and identity
preparation precedes the original callable/argument boundary; after any such
preparation the actual active record must be rechecked because GC can execute
a real selected child. The final guard preserves the original value and marks
only the actual attempted call after every original argument has evaluated.

The whole-operation series must retain a prefix while op7/8/9 and later SQL
run. A current weak-R3 holder alone does not supply that terminal lifetime.
A minimal future shared extension must represent an explicit operation-series
fact, disjoint from the one-shot foreign ACK. It may mechanically reserve,
record an actual attempted/returned occurrence, confirm the exact series
terminal, or retain on actual loss. HIA decides when to request these actions.
Association alone never marks an effect; exception names never infer loss.

Ancestor slots must be independently reserved before the effect, using only
actual live PID/thread ancestry and explicit opt-in. A journal foreign scope
with capture_resources=False is not an implicit parent resource capture.
Ordinary intermediate failures must remain confirmable; actual failed native
handoff or undelivered observed SQL outcomes remain unknown. Healthy
confirmation must release references before the next original lifetime
boundary; a post-confirmation bookkeeping error cannot invent a native loss.

The recovered transition-only R2 already proposes exact workspace custody and
full validation before NativeCall confirmation. It is frozen STATIC, not
qualified and not applied here. Current d90 transition still calls _entry
directly. The complete operation therefore needs that mechanically reviewed
transport prerequisite ported to current source, plus real fault execution.
Neither the recovered patch nor this design proves SQL ownership by itself.

## Independent future resource controls

resource-controls.json fixes 14 separately named control plans. They cover
prefix-before-INIT loss, confirmed ordinary rejection, later fold loss,
post-decision suffix SQL, nested release→lease, exact resource separation,
getter/connection identity, reservation versus observed-return failure,
temporary receivers, GC reentry, swallowed/replaced loss, Context/thread/fork,
healthy ACK cleanup and installed paired release.

Those controls must invoke saved actual entries before injecting a lost ACK.
They must retain full output/workspace bytes, source/image pins, rows, active
request state and exact receiver identity. No hand-written .loss, broad
exception-name predicate or skipped provider may stand in for actual loss.
The fake original-only 248 observations are not substitutes for these controls.

## Integration and default closure sequence

1. ROOT first runs the original-only pairs, reviews all complete raw output,
   fixes any observer infrastructure defect in a new revision, and freezes
   the independent original expectations per runtime.
2. Generate the complete new HIA controller and preserve the existing decision
   image. Use an explicit paired admission during development; selected
   controller failures never fall back to the retained whole method.
3. Integrate the transition custody prerequisite and the explicit series
   mechanism. Run the 14 real fault controls and full original component/
   caller gates in a single actual source snapshot.
4. Wire the accepted controller+decision pair into the real default release
   bundle/worker. One optional selector is not the completion criterion.
   An old selector-only compatibility path must remain honest until migrated;
   it cannot silently acquire a missing controller or be called native closure.
5. Only after current-source cold, installed/default worker and complete
   caller evidence may the retained 15-method reference be considered for
   deletion. All remaining foreign diagnostics and SQLite effects remain
   explicit, and whole-project legacy deletion is not justified by this unit.

No code implementing the controller, series API, new selector, generator,
registration or default bundle is included in this original-only revision.

Any runtime source divergence from a historical fixture requires explicit

## Remaining limits

The 248 inputs are finite new coverage, not a proof of all Python objects or
interpreter histories. Scripted receipts do not validate the existing HIA
decision semantics. There is no actual SQL, native image, cold source,
installed wheel, worker, default release or full-suite qualification here.
Raw external DB close, already-dead/unregistered receiver resurrection and
unrelated process resources are not claimed protected. The complete source
and every unexecuted step are listed in HANDOFF.json.
